Package ke.ric.renderer.api

Class MapFrame

java.lang.Object
ke.ric.renderer.api.MapFrame
public final class MapFrame extends Object
Immutable 128×128 Minecraft map palette plus the original frame that produced it. Stream sinks receive an aspect-fitted image with black letterboxing, without allocating or saving map items. The constructor and palette accessor copy bytes, so callers cannot change a published frame.

    • MapFrame

      public MapFrame(byte[] palette, RenderedFrame source)
      Copies exactly one map's palette and retains immutable source evidence.
      Parameters:
      palette - exactly 16384 row-major Minecraft map-palette bytes
      source - source frame, including original passes and final colour pixels
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if palette has the wrong size
      NullPointerException - if palette or source is null
